question: How wide were the paintings by the artist who was born prior to 1850?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "artists" AS SELECT "artistid" AS "artistid", "fname" AS "fname", "last_name" AS "last_name", "prefix" AS "prefix", "birthyear" AS "birthyear", "deathyear" AS "deathyear" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paintings" AS SELECT "paintingid" AS "paintingid", "title" AS "title", "year" AS "year", "h_mm" AS "h_mm", "w_mm" AS "w_mm", "medium" AS "medium", "support" AS "support", "location" AS "location", "painterid" AS "painterid" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  a.fname AS artist_first_name,
  a.last_name AS artist_last_name,
  a.birthyear,
  p.title AS painting_title,
  p.w_mm AS painting_width_mm
FROM artists a
JOIN paintings p
  ON p.painterid = a.artistid
WHERE a.birthyear IS NOT NULL
  AND a.birthyear < 1850
ORDER BY a.birthyear, a.last_name NULLS LAST, a.fname, p.title
LIMIT 50
